findings.finding: [states] Every update row without a feed icon shows a multicoloured orange box bitmap as its package icon. The artboard instead draws the neutral package codicon on a 36 px tile at the same place in every row, so the fallback adds decorative colour that the artboard lacks.
findings.evidence: Package icons are live content: the .NET row shows its feed icon, the sidecar masks the whole updates-list as live, and the artboard's neutral tile is a placeholder for any icon. The layout holds: DS-ICON-3 measures 36×36 ×14 and DS-RADIUS-2 icon 2px ×14, both hard. No rule asks for a codicon fallback, so rubric §6 excludes the finding.
